q: Which base makes up the largest percentage in human DNA?
Describe the pattern between A and T, and between G and C.
In every source A is about equal to T and G is about equal to C.
Predict the missing values for salmon.
T about 29.7%; G and C each about (100 − 59.4) / 2 = 20.3%.
Explain the pattern using the structure of DNA, and why the values are not exactly equal.
A always pairs with T and G with C across the double helix, so they are equal. Small differences come from measurement error.
